description: A front-end HTML file for a web-based database visualizer interface with embedded CSS and JavaScript. It provides UI components for browsing databases, tables, and displaying table data, including interactive features like refreshing, expanding cells, and responsive layout.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing the database’s table list and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for the selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for the selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table for the provided data, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a table cell, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses the content of a table cell to show full data or truncated preview.
